label: Test by Rivals of the fourteen stage-two attribute premises survive in finite tests
note: Tests the selected premise in the following setting. Same GoodIn and InAct predicates; one being, one respect. Control.actualityWithoutGoodness in Control.Certificate. Other four premises of StageTwo.GodIsSupremelyGood.godIsSupremelyGood hold: God is maximal in being, the maximum in a genus causes all in it, actuality only insofar as being, the cause of being causes every perfection. Its conclusion (God is supremely good) fails.
